relTest.notes: Google Drive: photos go during the inspection (Settings → Send photos during the inspection), so little is left when you finish; uploads keep going with the screen off; tap a project's cloud to send it first and see its progress; small changes go alone, even on mobile data; a notice when a finished project isn't in Drive after 3 hours. Windows/Mac: "From the phone" on Home shows what the phone is sending; Interviews → Edit people.
